title: Ravin bar Ulla
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in [Eruvin 8a](https://www.sefaria.org/Eruvin.8a.17) according to Dikdukei Soferim, where he addresses Rav Bivi bar Abaye as “my teacher.”[^1][^2]

notes.text: The William Davidson digital text of Eruvin 8a names Rabbah bar Ulla (רבה), addressing Rav Bivi bar Abaye as רבי, “my teacher.” Hyman reports Ravin from Dikdukei Soferim; the name forms are kept distinct.

[Heilprin’s Rabbah bar Ulla entry](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=3165&lang=en) cites the same address to Rav Bivi bar Abaye. In the Gemara, “my teacher” is a form of direct address. The name Ravin is Hyman’s reported reading from Dikdukei Soferim.
